description: This PHP source file defines the RedshiftDataAPIServiceClient class, part of the AWS SDK, used to interact with the Amazon Redshift Data API Service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to statements, tables, schemas, and databases, indicating the client's capabilities.

classes.name: RedshiftDataAPIServiceClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS Redshift Data API Service, providing methods for executing and managing SQL statements, and retrieving metadata from Redshift databases.

methods.name: batchExecuteStatement
methods.description: Executes a batch of SQL statements synchronously.

methods.name: batchExecuteStatementAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a batch of SQL statements.

methods.name: cancelStatement
methods.description: Cancels a specific SQL statement execution.

methods.name: cancelStatementAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a specific SQL statement.

methods.name: describeStatement
methods.description: Provides details about a specific SQL statement.

methods.name: describeStatementAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific SQL statement.

methods.name: describeTable
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a database table.

methods.name: getStatementResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result set of a SQL statement.
